_note: Brand marks shown on card faces, keyed by provider_id. A logo file (public/logos/<provider_id>.svg|png) is used only when it was taken from an official source recorded here with the date; otherwise the site renders a monogram. Logos stay the trademarks of their owners and identify the products compared (nominative use); any removal request is honoured.
